CURRENT SCENE:
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

ITEMS:

[I194] 凉山【^】很大的山   correction: ∅ → 是   strength: error
  checker's note: a predicate needs 是 here
  rule card (example_emphasis_connectors, Coherence: connectors): 比方说 introduces a following example; delete it when no example follows. 特别是+N, + Clause singles out a typical example, so N must be an example of the category.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <比方说> needs a following example, or <特别是+N, + Clause> must single out an N that is a typical example of <category>.  Her terms: 比方说, 特别是+N, + Clause
  her past correction: 这个大山⟦特别是⟧的 — her note: 特别是+N, + clause
  her past correction: 他[爬山→爬了很多山]
  her past correction: 他走过[有大有小山→大山小山]

[I195] 【这】也找植物   correction: 这 → 他   strength: error
  checker's note: this refers to Shennong, not a thing
  rule card (search_find, Vocabulary): 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person successfully finds <object>, so use 找到, not 找.  Her terms: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他[找有的花→找到一种植物] — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 他找了第一个[菜→植物]
  her past correction: 他[测试→尝试]别的植物

[I196] 他找到【^】黄色的花   correction: ∅ → 一朵   strength: error
  checker's note: a single flower needs a measure word
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他发现[-了]黄色花有毒 — her note: 发现is a mental state verb, no了
  her past correction: 他[找有的花→找到一种植物] — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: [-他]偶然看到了一朵美丽的黄花 — her note: redundant

[I197] 他听说【你跟】黄色的花做茶很有用   correction: 你跟 → 用   strength: error
  checker's note: 用 marks the material used to make tea
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 神农尝[+了]花儿以后就发现这个花儿不但可以被用做茶 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 他发现[-了]黄色花有毒 — her note: 发现is a mental state verb, no了
  her past correction: 喝茶对[-你的]身体有好处

[I198] 他听说你跟黄色的花做【^】茶很有用   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: links 做 to 茶 as the tea made from the flower
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: 他发现[-了]黄色花有毒 — her note: 发现is a mental state verb, no了
  her past correction: 神农尝[+了]花儿以后就发现这个花儿不但可以被用做茶 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 喝茶对[-你的]身体有好处

[I199] 你的头【发】疼死   correction: 发 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: a headache is 头疼, not hair hurting
  rule card (specific_noun_choice, Vocabulary): Use a specific noun or noun phrase when the story needs to say exactly what person, thing, plant, experience, or problem you mean. Avoid general words such as 人、东西、事情、水果, or vague phrases such as 有麻烦.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <wrong> is too general/vague here; say specifically what <person/thing/problem> it is.
  her past correction: [就疼死了→肚子/头就疼死了]
  her past correction: 可是[有很多麻烦→头疼起来了] — her note: “有很多麻烦” is too vague
  her past correction: [-他]累死了 — her note: delete他

[I200] 你的头发疼死【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [就疼死了→肚子/头就疼死了]
  her past correction: 可是[有很多麻烦→头疼起来了] — her note: “有很多麻烦” is too vague
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]

[I201] 这【冰】茶是药   correction: 冰 → 杯   strength: error
  checker's note: 杯 is the measure word for a cup of tea
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]喝了茶 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 喝茶对[-你的]身体有好处
  her past correction: [+是]药还是毒

[I202] 他一喝茶就【^】很不舒服   correction: ∅ → 觉得   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]喝了茶 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 他一看[+就]觉得担心
  her past correction: 喝茶对[-你的]身体有好处

items.explanation: A predicate needs 是 here: 凉山是很大的山.
This refers to Shennong, a person, so use 他, not 这.
A single flower needs a measure word. Say 一朵黄色的花.
用 marks the material used to make tea. Say 用黄色的花做茶.
It would be more natural to say 做的茶, which clearly means tea made from the flower.
头发 means “hair,” but a headache is 头疼. Delete 发 here.
This is a change of state in the story, so it takes 了completed: 头疼死了.
Use 杯 as the measure word for a cup of tea: 这杯茶是药.
It would be more natural to say 觉得很不舒服 to show his feeling after drinking the tea.
